snippet.title: Go Big - Out now!
snippet.description:
Go Big is a BBW weight gain game where you earn money in a Casino to feed a hungry ‘Glampire’ girl. With a roaring appetite for liquid cash, the more money you end up with, the fatter she grows. 

With 7 stages of weight gain, the beau of the night Carliva has big taste. Will luck play into your hand, or will this little birdie hold out for another high roller? 

Check out Go Big for FREE here! https://metrack.itch.io/go-big

Do you have the luck to Go Big?
